what: Per-problem comparison of T1 (base with cue, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0) and T2 (RL, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0) on MATH-500 under grader v3, with hand labels of the base failure on the 65 problems that RL solved and the base did not.
commit_note: HEAD when the script ran; the grader (lib/rln4_lib.py) and data/rln4/math500.json are the files of this commit. The script was in the working tree and is committed together with this folder.
where: laptop, saved rows only, no model forward pass
inputs_note: Both sha256 values equal the ones in results/rln4/grader_v3/readout.json (files.base_opener_1.0, files.rl_1.0).

files.per_problem.json: 500 rows, one per problem. The script's columns plus three columns joined on problem_index from the reader's table (see columns).
files.notes.md: The reader's notes, copied unchanged. The scratch scripts and intermediate files it names (score.py, feats.json, sig2.json and others) are not committed; sections 3 and 4 of the notes have no committed script.

hand_label_note: failure_type is a hand label by one reader, an agent, in one pass, with no second reader. It is set on the 65 rl_only rows and null elsewhere. label_from_tail_only marks the 7 rows labelled from the last 480 characters of the answer only.
level5_note: level5 came from a file outside the repo (math500_l5.json of another project, 134 problems, matched by problem text; path in notes.md section 3). data/rln4/math500.json has no level field, and levels 1 to 4 are not separated.
merge_check: The script's nine columns equal the reader's table on all 500 rows (0 differences).

examples.source: Short quotes already in notes.md; gold, extracted answer and score from grade_v3. The wrong quote is in the raw answer as written; the right quote is the notes' plain-text rendering of the LaTeX line that ends in \boxed{288 \pi}.

wrong.quote: b + c = 1.3 + 1.91 = 3.2 [...] Thus, the final answer is \boxed{3.2}
